# OpenMYC

> OpenMYC is a free search engine for comedy open mics in New York City, covering all five boroughs: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island.

OpenMYC helps comedians find open mics by day of the week, borough, time, cost, and venue type. The site is maintained by Kari Burt, a comedian based in NYC.

## Pages

- [Home](https://findopenmyc.com/): Search and filter open mics across NYC
- [Browse Mics](https://findopenmyc.com/mics): Full listing of all open mics with filters for borough, day, time, and cost
- [Mics Tonight](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/tonight): Open mics happening tonight in NYC
- [Free Mics](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/free): Open mics with no cover or sign-up fee
- [About](https://findopenmyc.com/about): About OpenMYC, the creator, and data sources
- [Submit a Mic](https://findopenmyc.com/submit): Submit a new open mic to be listed on OpenMYC
- [Contact](https://findopenmyc.com/contact): Contact OpenMYC
- [Privacy Policy](https://findopenmyc.com/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://findopenmyc.com/terms): Terms of service

## Borough Pages

- [Manhattan](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/manhattan): Every open mic in Manhattan
- [Brooklyn](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/brooklyn): Every open mic in Brooklyn
- [Queens](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/queens): Every open mic in Queens
- [Bronx](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/bronx): Every open mic in the Bronx
- [Staten Island](https://findopenmyc.com/mics/staten-island): Every open mic in Staten Island

## Borough + Day Pages

Borough/day combinations follow the pattern `https://findopenmyc.com/mics/{borough}/{day}`, where `{borough}` is one of `manhattan`, `brooklyn`, `queens`, `bronx`, `staten-island` and `{day}` is one of `sunday`, `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`. Example: https://findopenmyc.com/mics/brooklyn/wednesday

## Individual Mic Pages

Every mic has its own page at `https://findopenmyc.com/mics/{id}` with venue, address, host, cost, signup info, and an embedded map. Mic pages include schema.org Event structured data.

## API

- [Mics API](https://findopenmyc.com/api/mics): JSON API for querying open mics with parameters for borough, day, start_time, cost, offset, and limit

## Key Facts

- Covers all 5 NYC boroughs: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island
- Filterable by: day of week, borough, start time, cost (free or paid)
- Includes venue name, address, neighborhood, host info, signup instructions, and schedule
- Community-maintained: comedians can submit new mics via the submit form
- Completely free to use
- Contact: hello@findopenmyc.com
